title: Republican politician angered by Argentina sheltering Nazis

tellings.quote: was a an American political, a Republican, very sort of a right-wing kind of guy, very conservative, but he got really angry when he found out that the Argentines were protecting Nazi war criminals.

plain: Around 1945, an American Republican politician, a very conservative right-wing man, is said to have become furious when he found out that Argentina was protecting Nazi war criminals who had fled there after the war. The author Peter Levenda tells this without naming the man, drawing on the books Secret Machines War and The Hitler Legacy, as part of a larger story about Nazis and their secrets escaping to South America.
